title: Down bedding at an affordable cost.
text:
Down bedding at an affordable cost.. EDIT: In one year's time, over half the baffles are empty, having shed through the material enveloping them.
You can expect to find small feathers dug into your sheets. I'm not angry, just disappointed. Was hoping for something that lasted longer than a year.

ORIGINAL REVIEW:
I love this duvet. Absolute top-notch quality at a great price. I opened and let the comforter sit several hours before I fluffed it and put it on my bed.

My duvet cover had yet to arrive, but this duvet is soft and comfortable enough on its own. It gave me my first good night's sleep in two weeks.

Breathable and lightweight, this kept me warm, but didn't make me feel hot.

The stitching is well done and the duvet cover loops are double-stitched and of good quality.

The material is soft and comfortable, and, while there was a slight chemical scent on opening the package, it was gone in less than an hour.
